title: Studying and Working
text:
Many young people go to university after they finish school. There they study a subject that they like, such as biology or history. Some students also work part-time to pay for their classes and rent. This can be hard, but it helps them learn how to manage their time.

When students finish their studies, they look for a job in their field. Some choose to continue learning with a master's degree. Others start their own small business. Each path needs planning, and a good teacher or adviser can help students make the right choice.

questions.text: When do many young people go to university?
What can students do after they finish their studies, according to paragraph two?
options: Look for a job in their field

questions.text: Why might a student who works part-time learn to manage their time well?
options: Because they must balance work and study
Because they do not need money
Because their teachers tell them to rest

questions.text: What can the reader infer about the advice given in the last sentence?
options: Choosing a future path can be difficult without support
Students should never ask teachers for help
Starting a business is always the best choice
Planning is not needed for a career

vocabulary.definition: a place where people study after finishing school
for fewer hours than a full working day
to control or organise something well
a person who gives help and guidance about a choice

paragraph_translations: Muitos jovens vão para a universidade depois de terminar a escola. Lá eles estudam uma matéria de que gostam, como biologia ou história. Alguns estudantes também trabalham meio período para pagar as aulas e o aluguel. Isso pode ser difícil, mas os ajuda a aprender a organizar o tempo.

Quando os estudantes terminam os estudos, procuram um emprego na sua área. Alguns escolhem continuar aprendendo com um mestrado. Outros começam o seu próprio pequeno negócio. Cada caminho exige planejamento, e um bom professor ou conselheiro pode ajudar os estudantes a fazer a escolha certa.
